subject: general
question: Which of the following persons from the Military Nursing Service has been awarded the National Florence Nightingale Award 2020?

options.text: Surgeon Vice Admiral Sheila S Mathai

solution:
The correct answer is __**Brigadier SV Saraswati**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Brigadier SV Saraswati**__

 __
 
• President of India **Ram Nath Kovind** Present the award to Brigadier SV Saraswati in** Virtual ceremony**.
 
• Brigadier Saraswati hails from** chittoor district of Andhra Pradesh**.
 
• She was commissioned into the Military service nursing (MNS) on** December 28**, **1983**.
 
• As a renowned Operation Theatre Nurse, Brigadier Saraswati has assisted in over** 3,000** emergency and life saving surgeries.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **National Florence Nightingale Award**__

 
 
• **In 1973**, the Indian government instituted the National Florence Nightingale Award.
 
• The National Florence Nightingale Award is the** highest honor in the India **that a nurse can receive for exceptional professionalism.
 
• It is named after Florence Nightingale also known as the '**The** **Lady with the Lamp**'
 
• The National Florence Nightingale Award carries** Rs. 50,000 /- cash**.
